job.title: SOC Security Engineer / Vulnerability Management Specialist
job.description:
SOC Security Engineer / Vulnerability Management Specialist

Engagement Type: Contract-to-Hire
Location: Hybrid, Wayne, NJ area

Overview

We are seeking a Security Engineer to work closely alongside the SOC team as a key contributor to day-to-day security operations. This is an entry-to-mid-level opportunity for someone with a strong security foundation and a genuine interest in growing into penetration testing, vulnerability management, and incident response.

The role will provide some support around PCI compliance as needed, but the primary focus is hands-on cybersecurity operations rather than compliance administration.

This position will begin as a consultant/contract role, with the potential to convert to a full-time internal position based on future business needs and headcount approval.

What You'll Do

  • Support day-to-day SOC operations, including security monitoring and alert triage.

  • Assist with incident response activities, including identifying, escalating, and helping contain security incidents.

  • Perform vulnerability management, including scanning, tracking remediation, and coordinating with infrastructure and application teams to close security gaps.

  • Gain hands-on exposure to penetration testing methodologies and tools, with room to grow into this area over time.

  • Help maintain baseline security hardening across Windows, Linux, and cloud environments.

  • Provide backup support during PCI audit cycles when coordination or documentation assistance is needed.

  • Partner closely with the security operations team to improve processes and support higher-level security initiatives.

Who You Are

  • Foundational professional experience in cybersecurity. Entry-level candidates with relevant hands-on exposure will be considered.

  • Strong interest in building a long-term career specifically in cybersecurity, particularly SOC operations, incident response, vulnerability management, and penetration testing.

  • Basic familiarity with security fundamentals across Windows, Linux, and cloud environments such as AWS or Azure.

  • Comfortable learning new security tools, technologies, and processes.

  • Strong communication and follow-through, with the ability to coordinate with stakeholders and drive issues through resolution.

  • Collaborative team-player mindset and comfort working closely with other security professionals.

Nice to Have

  • Exposure to penetration testing tools, labs, or coursework.

  • Familiarity with PCI DSS or compliance audit processes.

  • Relevant security certifications such as Security+, CEH, or similar.

job.title: Systems Administrator
job.description:
Field Service / Systems Support Specialist

Location: New York, NY to start, with future relocation to Florida
Type: Contract
Schedule: Onsite
Start: ASAP

We are working on a great infrastructure support opportunity for someone who wants to build their career in a hands-on technical role and eventually relocate to Florida.

This role starts in New York City, where you will learn the environment, the team, the tools, and the support model. After that, the plan is for this person to relocate to Florida and become a key onsite technology resource for a growing operation.

This is a fun role for the right person. It is not sitting behind a ticket queue all day. It is hands-on, onsite, people-facing, and close to the infrastructure team.

You will support users, troubleshoot systems, help with field issues, assist with basic network administration, and become part of a team that is actively expanding.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Provide onsite field service and systems support

  • Support Windows and Mac laptops, desktops, mobile devices, printers, peripherals, and conference room technology

  • Troubleshoot hardware, software, connectivity, authentication, and access issues

  • Support Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, Zoom, and collaboration tools

  • Help with basic network troubleshooting, including Wi-Fi, switch ports, access points, DHCP/DNS, and general connectivity

  • Assist with device deployments, refreshes, imaging, moves, adds, changes, and equipment setup

  • Work closely with infrastructure, networking, security, and application teams

  • Learn the environment in NYC and bring that knowledge to a growing Florida operation

  • Document common issues, fixes, site details, and escalation paths

  • Own problems through resolution and communicate clearly with users and the technical team

What We’re Looking For

  • 3+ years of desktop support, field service, systems support, or end-user technology support experience

  • Strong hands-on troubleshooting with Windows and macOS

  • Experience supporting Microsoft 365 and/or Google Workspace

  • Basic networking knowledge, including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, Wi-Fi, switch ports, and general connectivity troubleshooting

  • Experience with printers, mobile devices, peripherals, conference rooms, AV, or onsite technology

  • Comfortable working onsite in a fast-paced environment

  • Strong communication and customer service skills

  • Someone dependable, professional, and willing to jump in where needed

  • Interest in relocating to Florida after learning the environment in NYC

Nice to Have

  • Experience in a multi-site environment

  • Exposure to Cisco Meraki, Cisco switches, access points, or similar network tools

  • Experience with Jamf, Intune, Apple Business Manager, or endpoint management tools

  • Experience supporting iPads, Chromebooks, Macs, Windows laptops, or shared technology environments

  • Prior experience with new site openings, office moves, field support, or technology rollouts

Why This Role Is Interesting

This is a good fit for someone who wants more than a standard support job.

You will get exposure to desktop, systems, field service, basic networking, infrastructure operations, and a growing Florida buildout. You will start by learning from an established team in NYC, then have the chance to take that knowledge with you and become an important technical resource in a new market.

If you are hands-on, sharp, reliable, and interested in relocating to Florida, this could be a really strong opportunity.

Who Should Apply

This is ideal for someone who:

  • Likes being onsite and solving real technical problems

  • Enjoys working directly with users and technical teams

  • Wants exposure to both systems and infrastructure

  • Has enough networking knowledge to troubleshoot connectivity issues

  • Wants to grow into a bigger field / infrastructure support role

  • Is seriously interested in relocating to Florida

Job Title

Security Engineering Manager

About the Opportunity

Are you a hands-on technical leader ready to shape the defensive architecture of a modern, cloud-first infrastructure? We are seeking a Security Engineering Manager to guide a high-performing team of engineers while driving application security and cloud protection strategies across our modern software ecosystem. In this role, you will bridge strategic security vision with deep technical execution, empowering product and engineering teams to build fast without sacrificing security.

Responsibilities

  • Technical Guidance & Architecture: Provide direct technical oversight for complex security challenges, conduct thorough architecture reviews, and maintain active hands-on involvement with cloud defensive configurations.

  • Program Direction: Drive the continuous evolution of our application security and cloud posture initiatives throughout every stage of the software development lifecycle.

  • Team Leadership: Lead, mentor, and cultivate a dedicated team of security engineers, fostering a high-ownership culture focused on professional growth and technical rigor.

  • Strategic Delivery: Plan, track, and execute security engineering initiatives from design through deployment, guaranteeing alignment with broader organizational risk priorities.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Product and DevOps leaders to embed preventative security standards directly into engineering roadmaps and development workflows.

  • Risk Reduction: Proactively identify infrastructure vulnerabilities, remove operational roadblocks, and maintain momentum on remediation efforts across all engineering domains.

Requirements

  • 7+ years of progressive information security experience, with specialized expertise in AppSec, DevSecOps, or cloud infrastructure defense.

  • Demonstrated experience managing and developing technical teams while successfully delivering complex security projects.

  • Deep technical mastery of secure software development practices, CI/CD pipeline protections, secrets administration, and application vulnerabilities.

  • Exceptional ability to translate high-level security frameworks into concrete engineering deliverables for both dedicated security staff and partner development teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience configuring cloud-native security controls, including DSPM, CSPM, and workload protection solutions within AWS environments.

  • Familiarity with automated application scanning methodologies (SAST/DAST/SCA) and IaC deployment frameworks (e.g., Terraform, cloud automation suites).

  • Experience securing enterprise-grade web applications, business-critical administrative systems, or custom CRM platforms.

  • Strong understanding of identity lifecycle management across human users, non-human service accounts, and API access tokens.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Competitive base salary with performance-based incentive structures.

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision health plans.

  • 401(k) retirement plan with employer matching.

  • Flexible work arrangements (Remote/Hybrid options) and generous paid leave.

job.title: DataCenter Estimator
job.description:
Estimator

Estimator Skills Required

  • Minimum of 2 years of experience as an installer within a data center environment.

  • Working knowledge of infrastructure builds utilizing strut/channel, fiber trays, ladder racks, and wire basket.

  • Working knowledge of the installation, termination, and testing of fiber optic and copper cabling / structured wiring.

  • Computer proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Microsoft Word, Microsoft Outlook, SAP, Bluebeam, and Visio.

  • Knowledge of labor units based on real-world experience as well as published resources such as RSMeans, NECA, etc.

  • Ability to produce professional quotes with clear scope-of-work narratives that provide installers with accurate instructions for the work to be performed.

  • Strong proofreading skills, including the ability to review Excel-based estimate sheets for accuracy and mathematical errors with minimal oversight.

  • Comfortable conducting site surveys and field visits to gather project information and review customer expectations.

  • Comfortable working in person in an office environment in Northern New Jersey.

  • Comfortable working standard office hours, Monday through Friday.

Key Hiring Requirements

This is not a traditional estimator position. The estimating process requires estimators to identify every material needed for a data center build, down to individual hardware components.

There is a strong preference for candidates who come from the field, particularly the installation or build-out side, and are interested in transitioning into an office-based estimating role. Candidates with estimating experience but limited hands-on data center installation experience may have a steeper learning curve.

The ideal candidate should understand:

  • White space build-outs

  • Ladder rack, threaded rod, strut, spring nuts, fasteners, cage hardware, and two-post/four-post racks

  • Fiber infrastructure, terminations, rack layouts, and installation methods

  • Bills of materials (BOM), takeoffs, scopes of work, and labor estimating

  • Excel-based estimating and custom estimating templates

Candidates must be able to visualize the physical installation while developing an estimate, as drawings may consist of simple Visio layouts or rough sketches rather than fully engineered blueprints.

Field experience is especially important. Candidates should already understand the fundamentals of data center infrastructure and structural hardware. Junior candidates may be considered if they possess a strong foundation, although experienced candidates capable of working independently with minimal supervision are preferred.

Individuals with experience working for an industrial or commercial electrical contractor in the metro area may also possess transferable skills that are beneficial for this role.

Frequently Used Materials & Methods

  • Versabar / Strut / Channel

  • Spring Nuts
